crossRefs.note: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.
These also are sayings of the wise. To show partiality in judgment is not good.
“You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.
“You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.
You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls who should not…
Their drink has become sour. They play the prostitute continually. Her rulers dearly love their shameful way.
Yahweh says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray; for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!”…
Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe; and the powerful man…

translations.web: To show partiality is not good; yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.
translations.bsb: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.
translations.kjv: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.
translations.asv: To have respect of persons is not good; Neither that a man should transgress for a piece of bread.
